nodes.label: Camera2 App
nodes.description: Primary AOSP camera application. Implements photo, video, and panorama modes using the android.hardware.camera2 Java API.

nodes.label: LegacyCamera
nodes.description: Legacy camera application using the deprecated Camera API. Kept for compatibility testing.

nodes.label: DevCamera
nodes.description: Developer-facing camera diagnostics and test application.

nodes.label: 3rd-party App
nodes.description: Any third-party Android application using the android.hardware.camera2 Java API or CameraX Jetpack library.

nodes.label: NDK Camera App
nodes.description: C/C++ native application using the ACameraManager_* NDK API (libcamera2ndk). Avoids JVM overhead for latency-sensitive use cases.

nodes.label: CameraManager
nodes.description: Top-level system service wrapper. Enumerates available cameras, opens a CameraDevice, registers availability/access-priority callbacks.

nodes.label: CameraDevice
nodes.description: Represents an open connection to a physical camera. Creates CameraCaptureSessions and submits CaptureRequests.

nodes.label: CameraDeviceImpl
nodes.description: Concrete implementation of CameraDevice. Communicates with CameraDeviceClient in CameraService via Binder IPC.

nodes.label: CameraCaptureSession
nodes.description: Configured capture session with a set of output Surfaces. Submits single or repeating CaptureRequests to the camera pipeline.

nodes.label: CaptureRequest
nodes.description: Immutable package of capture parameters (exposure, ISO, focus, flash, output targets) for a single image capture operation.

nodes.label: CaptureResult
nodes.description: Per-frame metadata returned after a capture: actual AE/AF/AWB state, sensor timestamp, lens position, and output buffer timestamps.

nodes.label: CameraCharacteristics
nodes.description: Static properties of a camera device: sensor physical size, supported formats/sizes, capabilities, AE/AF/AWB modes, and lens info.

nodes.label: CameraExtensionSession
nodes.description: Capture session that enables OEM/vendor processing extensions: Night mode, HDR, Bokeh, Face Retouch, Auto White Balance tuning.

nodes.label: CameraOfflineSession
nodes.description: Allows in-flight capture requests to complete after the camera device is closed, enabling low-power offline post-processing.

nodes.label: NdkCameraManager
nodes.description: NDK entry point (ACameraManager). Enumerates cameras and opens NdkCameraDevice. Wraps the native libcamera Binder proxy.

nodes.label: NdkCameraDevice
nodes.description: NDK camera device (ACameraDevice). Creates NdkCameraCaptureSession and submits ACaptureRequests from C/C++ code.

nodes.label: NdkCaptureSession
nodes.description: NDK capture session (ACameraCaptureSession). Submits requests and receives results entirely in native C/C++ code without JVM.

nodes.label: Camera.cpp
nodes.description: Native Binder proxy to CameraService (libcamera). Used internally by NDK and the Java JNI bridge layer.

nodes.label: CameraMetadata
nodes.description: Native C++ helper for reading and writing HAL-level camera metadata key-value pairs. Serializes metadata between service and HAL.

nodes.label: CameraService
nodes.description: System Binder service running in the cameraserver process. Manages device lifecycle, client arbitration, permission checks, and flashlight control.

nodes.label: CameraDeviceClient
nodes.description: Server-side Camera2 API session handler. Translates Java/NDK CaptureRequests into HAL stream configurations and buffer queues.

nodes.label: Camera3Device
nodes.description: HAL3 device abstraction layer. Manages the request/result pipeline, enforces ordering, handles partial results and error recovery.

nodes.label: Camera3OutputStream
nodes.description: Represents an output stream (preview Surface, ImageReader, MediaRecorder) backed by an ANativeWindow. Manages gralloc buffer lifecycle.

nodes.label: Camera3BufferMgr
nodes.description: Manages gralloc buffer allocation, import, and recycling for camera output streams. Coordinates buffer sharing across multiple streams.

nodes.label: CameraProviderMgr
nodes.description: Discovers and manages camera HAL providers via ICameraProvider AIDL. Handles HAL process death/restart and multi-provider scenarios.

nodes.label: CameraFlashlight
nodes.description: Independent torch/flashlight control. Allows torch-mode access without opening a full camera session (requires HAL support).

nodes.label: VirtualCameraService
nodes.description: Virtual camera HAL service backed by an ANativeWindow Surface. Enables screen-capture cameras, virtual conferencing devices, and injection testing.

nodes.label: CameraExtProxy
nodes.description: Proxy service that routes CameraExtensionSession requests from the framework to the appropriate OEM vendor extension implementation.

nodes.label: ICameraProvider
nodes.description: AIDL interface for a camera HAL provider. Enumerates camera devices, provides ICameraDevice handles, and notifies status changes to the framework.

nodes.label: ICameraDevice
nodes.description: AIDL interface for a single camera device. Provides static metadata (CameraCharacteristics) and opens an ICameraDeviceSession for streaming.

nodes.label: ICameraDeviceSession
nodes.description: AIDL interface for an active camera streaming session. Configures output streams, submits capture requests, and manages the HAL buffer queue.

nodes.label: ICameraDeviceCallback
nodes.description: HAL-to-framework callback interface: notify shutter, notify error, processCaptureResult. Delivers completed image buffers and metadata back to CameraService.

nodes.label: Google Camera HAL
nodes.description: Reference Camera HAL3 implementation by Google. Implements ICameraProvider/ICameraDevice/ICameraDeviceSession. Handles request processing, result merging, and stream routing.

nodes.label: USB Camera HAL
nodes.description: HAL implementation for UVC-compliant USB cameras. Detects hotplug via HotplugThread and reads MJPEG/YUV frames through V4L2 ioctls.

nodes.label: Legacy HAL (3.x)
nodes.description: Legacy HAL3.0/3.4 skeleton implementation used as a base template for older SoC vendor HAL ports.

nodes.label: Virtual Camera HAL
nodes.description: Virtual camera HAL backed by a Surface producer. Injects synthetic frames into the pipeline for testing, screen-sharing, and virtual device scenarios.

nodes.label: OEM / Vendor HAL
nodes.description: SoC/OEM-specific camera HAL implementing ICameraProvider and ICameraDeviceSession for proprietary sensor and ISP pipelines (Qualcomm, Samsung, MediaTek, etc.).

nodes.label: V4L2
nodes.description: Video for Linux 2 kernel subsystem. Provides /dev/videoX device nodes and the VIDIOC_* ioctl interface consumed by camera HALs to control sensors and capture frames.

nodes.label: Media Controller
nodes.description: Kernel media controller framework. Models the camera pipeline as a graph (sensor → ISP → output). Configures routing between V4L2 subdevices via MEDIA_IOC_SETUP_LINK.

nodes.label: Sensor Driver
nodes.description: Camera image sensor kernel driver. Configures sensor registers over I2C (exposure, gain, framerate, resolution), sets streaming mode, and produces MIPI CSI-2 RAW data.

nodes.label: ISP Driver
nodes.description: Image Signal Processor kernel driver. Programs ISP registers for demosaic, noise reduction, HDR merge, lens shading correction, and 3A statistics (AE/AF/AWB).

nodes.label: Flash Driver
nodes.description: Flash/torch LED kernel driver. Controls flash intensity and strobe timing via I2C or GPIO. Registers as a V4L2 flash subdevice for synchronized capture.

nodes.label: Lens Actuator Drv
nodes.description: Voice Coil Motor (VCM) lens actuator kernel driver. Moves the lens to achieve auto-focus by adjusting coil current via I2C. Exposes position via V4L2 controls.

nodes.label: CMOS Image Sensor
nodes.description: Physical CMOS image sensor (e.g., Sony IMX766, Samsung GN2). Converts photons to analog signal, digitizes to RAW Bayer data, and outputs pixels over MIPI CSI-2 lanes.

nodes.label: ISP Chip
nodes.description: Dedicated or integrated Image Signal Processor. Performs demosaicing, multi-frame NR, HDR, tone mapping, lens shading correction, and outputs YUV/JPEG frames.

nodes.label: Lens + VCM
nodes.description: Optical lens assembly with Voice Coil Motor actuator. Physically moves lens groups for optical auto-focus (OAF) and Optical Image Stabilization (OIS).

nodes.label: Flash LED
nodes.description: High-intensity dual-tone LED flash module. Provides illumination for still photo capture and continuous low-intensity torch for video.

nodes.label: MIPI CSI-2 PHY
nodes.description: Physical layer interface for the MIPI CSI-2 serial bus. Transports RAW pixel data from the image sensor to the ISP at multi-Gbps bandwidth over differential lanes.
